name: Het Pentagon

attribution.title: Het Pentagon, Sint Antoniesbreestraat / Zwanenburgwal, Amsterdam (Theo Bosch, 1983)
attribution.author: Map Recall
attribution.modifications: Original texture-free flat-colour geometry on the 3DBAG LoD2.2 shells (CC BY 4.0) of BAG panden 0363100012171628 and 0363100012178153 (CC0): the exposed concrete frame with white-framed glazing and pale spandrel panels on every exposed wall, the Sint Antoniesbreestraat shop arcade with its raking white struts, clerestories, red shop frames and round columns, the curved and half-round balconies on round columns, read from Gemeente Amsterdam panoramas (CC BY 4.0) and the municipal monument register text. No pixels or meshes imported.
